KYUNGSUNG UNIVERSITY
FACT SHEET 
International Exchange Program
2027-Spring semester
Introduction 
of 
KYUNGSUNG 
UNIVERSITY
LOCATION
▪ Kyungsung University is located in Busan, South Korea’s second-largest city. 
This vibrant coastal city is home to two of South Korea’s most famous 
beaches—Haeundae Beach and Gwangalli Beach.
CAMPUS LIFE
▪ Our campus is safe, welcoming, and conveniently located! It offers easy 
access to the subway transits and numerous bus routes.
UNDERGRADUATE COLLEGES
▪ Kyungsung University has  9 undergraduate colleges:
• Arts
• College of Sciences
• Creative Human Resource
• Pharmacy
• Global College
• Bio & Health
• Commerce and Economics
• Engineering
• Liberal Arts and Social Sciences
• Leaders in INdustry-university INnovation
Convergence
as of  2026, encompassing 9 different schools and 51 department.
Introduction 
of 
KYUNGSUNG 
UNIVERSITY
GRADUATE SCHOOLS
▪ Kyungsung University offers:
▪ General: 54 master’s courses and 39 doctoral courses
▪ Education: 5 majors 
▪ Social Welfare: 1 major 
ENGLISH TRACK COURSES (Global College)
▪ We offer English-taught courses at the Global College
▪ School of Global Studies: Global Business Administration, Global 
Hospitality Management, Global Korean Studies
▪ School of Global Engineering Studies: Global Mechanical Design 
Engineering, Global IT Engineering
FACULTY & STUDENTS
▪ With over 700 faculty members and more than 16,000 students, Kyungsung
University fosters a collaborative environment dedicated to achieving its 
educational goals.
• The fall semester refers to the second semester of the academic year.
• Nomination and Application documents must be submitted via email 
(arko0910@ks.ac.kr)
• There is no need to submit application documents by international mail.
• Dates are subject to change
